verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing-page claim that Bento ties sales and recurring revenue back to the preceding email or flow, which covers conversion attribution at the campaign/flow level. Unique-event handling supports accurate revenue counting. Nothing documents open, click, or unsubscribe reporting per broadcast or per workflow step, or any trend view over time. Missing for 10: documented per-campaign open/click/unsubscribe metrics, per-automation-step analytics, time-series reporting, any first-party analytics docs or independent corroboration.
